No. The data show no tree-cover loss events in 2024 or 2025 within this property. The series is observed through 2025, with full valid-data coverage, so those years were covered. Events are counted only if they are at least 0.5 ha, so smaller patches would not appear as events. The sub-0.5 ha patches listed are for 2021–2023 only.

Corroborated loss after the 2020 baseline occurred only earlier:
- 2021: 81.3 ha (2.23% of the asset, planted forest context)
- 2022: 0.6 ha (mixed context)
- 2023: 4.5 ha (planted forest context)

Caveat: this is Hansen tree-cover loss, which includes any stand replacement, such as harvesting a plantation. It does not show deforestation, the cause, legality, who was responsible, or compliance status.
